definitions.explanation: Showing opposition or resistance to authority, rules, or control. Describes an attitude of defiance or unwillingness to comply.

examples.japanese: {反抗的|はんこうてき}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧。
⟦{思春期|ししゅんき}→思春期：12667_shishunki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{反抗的|はんこうてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧やすい。
⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{反抗的|はんこうてき}な⟦{目|め}つき→目つき：23141_metsuki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見|み}つめた→見つめる：04571_mitsumeru⟧。
examples.english: The student stared at the teacher with a defiant look.

notes:
A na-adjective describing a rebellious or defiant attitude. Very commonly used when discussing adolescents, particularly during the ⟦{反抗期|はんこうき}→反抗期：15877_hankouki⟧ (rebellious phase). Can describe attitudes, behavior, looks, or speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {反抗的|はんこうてき}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧: defiant attitude
- {反抗的|はんこうてき}な⟦{目|め}つき→目つき：23141_metsuki⟧: defiant look
- {反抗的|はんこうてき}な⟦{言動|げんどう}→言動：14147_gendou⟧: rebellious words and actions
- {反抗的|はんこうてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become defiant

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{反抗|はんこう}→反抗：03568_hankou⟧: rebellion, defiance — the base noun
- ⟦{反抗期|はんこうき}→反抗期：15877_hankouki⟧: rebellious phase — the developmental stage of adolescent rebellion, a very commonly discussed concept in Japanese parenting

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{反発|はんぱつ}→反発：08676_hanpatsu⟧: opposition, pushback — focuses on the reaction against pressure or force
- ⟦{生意気|なまいき}→生意気：08271_namaiki⟧: cheeky, impudent — less serious, implies cocky attitude rather than genuine rebellion
